# Serving layer rules

## One thread owns the model

All model access goes through `EngineCore` in `app/core.py` — a dedicated thread
running a scheduler loop. **Only that thread ever touches the model.**

Never call the model from a request thread. Never hold a lock across a whole
decode; that is the head-of-line blocking `core.py` exists to remove.

## Backpressure is intentional

When the bulk queue is full, `submit_bulk` raises `EngineBusy` and the HTTP layer
returns `503` with `Retry-After`. This converts unbounded latency growth into a
fast, honest refusal. Do not make the queue unbounded, and do not swallow
`EngineBusy`.

## Priority

- **interactive** — one callable, run immediately, never delayed to batch.
  A streaming step or a flush.
- **bulk** — audio pieces from `transcribe()`, coalesced by decode signature.

Interactive preempts bulk at sub-batch granularity. At least one sub-batch must
run per scheduler iteration, or gathered work can be starved into livelock.

## This is CTC, not autoregressive

One forward pass per piece. No KV cache, no continuous batching, no paged
attention, no token-level scheduling. Do not propose them.

## VAD

- Runs on request threads, never the model thread.
- Lazy and optional: a missing `silero-vad` degrades to energy-based splitting,
  never fails the request.
- `silero_vad.model` calls `torch.set_num_threads(1)` at import time. `app/vad.py`
  captures and restores the thread count around the import — keep that guard.

## Cut points

`app/audio.py::split_with_offsets` must mirror
`quan_transcribe/audio.py::split_quiet` cut-for-cut, or segment timestamps are
subtly wrong. Change one, change the other.

## Errors

Use the existing types: `APIError` (OpenAI envelope), `AudioDecodeError`,
`EngineBusy` (retry), `EngineNotReady`. Do not raise bare `ValueError` where one
of these fits.

## Generated code

`app/proto/*_pb2*.py` is generated by `protoc`. Regenerate, never hand-edit.

## Verify

```bash
pytest -q
```

`app/core.py` and `app/engine.py` are the highest-risk files — run the full
suite, not a filtered subset.
